parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The load balancer ID, which uniquely identifies the load balancer to query. This ID is returned when the load balancer is created. You can also call the [ListLoadBalancers](~~2868897~~) operation to obtain all load balancers under a site.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
